_about: List 18's phase 4: the squares' stand designs (docs/improvements18_plan.md). Drafted 2026-11-27 from the meshes' bounds read out of their .uasset files (no editor). Frame: the stand's middle at the origin, its counter facing +X, the buyer at +X, the keeper at x -200; every part within x, y -130..130, nothing below 210 cm at x < -110. A part: mesh (or box), actor (a Blueprint), x y z its pivot in cm, yaw in degrees, scale (uniform or [sx, sy, sz] in the mesh's own axes), footprint [x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1] in the stand's frame as worked out from the mesh's bounds. A box part: box [cx, cy, cz, ex, ey, ez] middle and half extents, material a heaven_kit instance. Sizes are to be checked in 951 stalls' editor run (the plan's own rule).
